You should buy from **Seller A - Brackmoor Sound** - `https://listing-test-sooty.vercel.app/r/gsnc4s/a`

Both listings are for the exact same product at the exact same price, so the return policy is the deciding factor:

| | **A - Brackmoor Sound** | **B - Ottervale Audio** |
|---|---|---|
| **Price** | $129.00 | $129.00 |
| **Shipping** | Free standard shipping, arrives in 3-5 business days | Free standard shipping, arrives in 3-5 business days |
| **Stock** | In stock | In stock |
| **Rating** | 4.3 / 5 (210 reviews) | 4.3 / 5 (210 reviews) |
| **Warranty** | 1-year limited warranty | 1-year limited warranty |
| **Returns** | **Free 90-day returns** | **30-day returns. Buyer pays return shipping** |
| **Specs** | Identical - 40hr battery with ANC on, Bluetooth 5.3, 254g, USB-C, graphite, etc. | Identical |

**Why A is better:**

Everything else - price, shipping speed/cost, warranty, product specs, and even the customer rating - is identical. 

Seller A gives you 3x longer to return it (90 days vs 30 days) and you don't have to pay for return shipping if you don't like them or have an issue. Seller B makes you pay return shipping and only gives you 30 days.

That makes Seller A much lower-risk for the same $129. If you don't need to make a return, there's no difference, but if you do need to return, A will save you money and hassle.
